summary: Iter113 verified: (1) access-globe suspicious/has_trust — baseline no-trust returns has_trust=false, suspicious=0, all points suspicious=false; after PUT trusted_countries=['United States'], has_trust=true and >0 pins flagged suspicious (AU accesses). (2) access-globe.pdf still returns valid 3+ page PDF (~%PDF header). (3) snapshot-status returns {snapshot_incidents:2, live_source_connected:false, live_source:''}; retire-snapshots returns HTTP 409 with 'live'/'connect'/'source' message; snapshot count unchanged after gated call (nothing deleted). (4) Regression: governance PUT dedupe/validate for trusted_countries + trusted_ip_ranges (invalid dropped, dupes collapsed, empties trimmed); shared-cards, access-log.csv, board-evidence-digest all respond <500; cron/weekly-drift-digest returns 202 with Bearer WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET. Baseline restored (trusted_countries=[], trusted_ip_ranges=[]). Frontend: Control Assurance globe now shows ca-globe-filters with All(116) / Downloads(34) / Suspicious(0) chips; clicking Suspicious renders ca-globe-filter-empty with text 'No suspicious accesses to plot.'; Downloads/All chips clickable; ca-globe-export + ca-globe-refresh present. Defensibility tab -> Governance card footer gov-snapshot-retire shows '2 SNAPSHOT record(s) present · live source not connected' and gov-retire-snapshots button is DISABLED as required.
critical_code_review_comments: _gather_access_globe cleanly exposes has_trust + suspicious count and per-point suspicious flag; trust list PUT flips flags immediately (no cache staleness).
retire-snapshots gate is enforced server-side (HTTP 409) and confirmed non-destructive: snapshot_incidents count preserved after gated POST — matches design intent.
_build_board_access_map_pdf helper refactor holds: access-globe.pdf continues to be a valid multi-page branded PDF, exercising the same code path used by the board-evidence-digest attachment.
weekly-drift-digest cron enqueues _run_unusual_access_watchlist alongside existing tasks and still returns 202 quickly (background_tasks pattern preserved).

Final GET confirmed trusted_countries=[] and trusted_ip_ranges=[] baseline restored. 2 SNAPSHOT ai_incidents intentionally preserved (gate refused deletion).
